caption:
Koko carries a heavy camera all day and crouches for the low shots. By the end of every shoot, her neck and back ache.

Holding one position for a long time, or hanging gear off one shoulder, can tire your body out. Using your trunk and changing position often can share the load.

Hybi's tip: breathe out and draw your tummy in 5 times, do 5 bird dogs each side, and stand up and lengthen after low shots. A cross-body bag or backpack spreads the weight.

Tingling in your arm or hand, or pain at night, are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio 📷
